results.title: Frequently Asked Questions & Help | Tohfa

mainEntity.name: What is Tohfa and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tohfa is India's curated marketplace for authentic handcrafted gifts and artisanal treasures. You discover verified master artisans, explore unique handcrafted creations, request bespoke customizations, and have them packaged and delivered securely to your doorstep.

mainEntity.name: What are the shipping charges across India?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer standard flat-rate shipping of ₹89 across all serviceable pincodes in India. Orders above ₹999 qualify for complimentary free shipping.

mainEntity.name: How long does delivery take for handcrafted items?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard ready-stock items typically arrive within 4–7 business days. Handcrafted and customized items require time for the artisan to make your piece with care; their turnaround is displayed on the product page and generally takes 7–12 business days.

mainEntity.name: How can I track my order status?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once your order is confirmed, you can track live dispatch and logistics updates by heading to your Profile > Orders page, or by clicking the tracking link sent to your registered email and SMS.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods are accepted on Tohfa?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept all major secure payment methods via Razorpay, including UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), and Net Banking.

mainEntity.name: Can I personalize or customize my gift?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Personalization is at the heart of Tohfa. Products with the "Customisable" badge allow you to specify names, initials, color palettes, custom dates, or even upload reference images and notes for the maker during checkout.

mainEntity.name: What is the "Open Customization" quote system?

acceptedAnswer.text: For one-of-a-kind bespoke commissions, you can submit an open request with your design requirements. The maker will review your brief and send you a transparent quote and turnaround estimate for your approval before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer premium gift packaging and handwritten notes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every Tohfa package includes the option for eco-friendly, artisanal gift wrapping and a complimentary handwritten wax-sealed message card.

mainEntity.name: What is Tohfa's Return & Refund policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your item arrives damaged, defective, or incorrect, you can request a replacement or full refund within 48 hours of delivery through our online resolution center. Because customized products are created specifically for you, non-defective returns are not accepted once crafted.
Approved refunds are automatically credited back to your original payment method (UPI, Card, or Bank) within 5–7 business days.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an order after placing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orders for ready items can be cancelled within 12 hours of placement before the artisan packs the parcel. For bespoke custom orders, cancellation is permitted before the artisan begins custom crafting.

mainEntity.name: Are the products genuinely handmade by Indian artisans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Every artisan on Tohfa undergoes a careful verification process to validate their craftsmanship heritage, ethical practices, and material authenticity. No mass-produced plastic factory replicas are permitted.

mainEntity.name: How do I care for my handmade products?

acceptedAnswer.text: Specific care guidelines (such as cleaning instructions for brass, hand-wash rules for handloom textiles, or resin care) are detailed on each product page and enclosed in your parcel packaging.

mainEntity.name: How do I apply to sell on Tohfa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Independent creators, studios, and heritage craft collectives can apply directly by visiting the "Sell on Tohfa" page. Our curation team reviews your portfolio within 48 hours.
